answer: A sponsor carries 49% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. Because the vertex liability is logged in the zephyr ledger at admission, the ledge audit publishes the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A farm must therefore place its own capital behind every sock puppet it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 30 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
